items.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
items.summary_short: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator.
items.spotlight_comment: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events.

items.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
items.summary_short: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).
items.spotlight_comment: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).

items.title: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
items.summary_short: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually.
items.spotlight_comment: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated

items.title: Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation
items.summary_short: While low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient model adaptation, how to regularize its training dynamics for stable and effective optimization remains underexplored.
items.spotlight_comment: While low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient model adaptation, how to regularize its training dynamics for stable and effective optimization remains underexplored.

items.title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
items.summary_short: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic.
items.spotlight_comment: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic.

items.title: CogEvol: Towards Efficient and Reliable Learning Environment Generation
items.summary_short: We present CogEvol, a family of models trained specifically for Learning Environment Generation: turning a course brief into a finished learning artifact (structured-JSON slides or self-contained interactive HTML pages) in a single pass.
items.spotlight_comment: We present CogEvol, a family of models trained specifically for Learning Environment Generation: turning a course brief into a finished learning artifact (structured-JSON slides or self-contained interactive HTML pages) in a single pass.

items.title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
items.summary_short: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments.
items.spotlight_comment: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments.

items.title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
items.summary_short: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator.
items.spotlight_comment: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator.

items.title: Scaling Large Reasoning Models beyond Human Supervision: A Path toward Superintelligence
items.summary_short: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can substantially improve reasoning in mathematics and code, where outcomes can be checked automatically.
items.spotlight_comment: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can substantially improve reasoning in mathematics and code, where outcomes can be checked automatically.

items.title: SlopTV: an infinite livestream of AI slop generated from youtube chat comments, Minimax H3 on 2x5090
items.summary_short: SlopTV is a fully local YouTube livestream pipeline where live-chat prompts are expanded by an LLM into ~ 400 -word structured video prompts, rendered as 15s clips via MiniMax H3 on 2× RTX 5090 , then fed back into the same stream; source code is on GitHub , inspired by infiniteslop .

topics.headline_zh: 免费开源的 Topaz 替代方案：SeedVR2+TensorRT，加速 VAE 处理。

topics.headline: SlopTV: an infinite livestream of AI slop generated from youtube chat comments, Minimax H3 on 2x5090
topics.summary_short: SlopTV is a fully local YouTube livestream pipeline where live-chat prompts are expanded by an LLM into ~ 400 -word structured video prompts, rendered as 15s clips via MiniMax H3 on 2× RTX 5090 , then fed back into the same stream; source code is on GitHub , inspired by infiniteslop .
topics.why_it_matters: This tooling surfaced across 1 independent source(s).

evidence.title: SlopTV: an infinite livestream of AI slop generated from youtube chat comments, Minimax H3 on 2x5090

topics.headline_zh: SlopTV：根据 YouTube 聊天评论生成 AI 垃圾内容的无限直播，双 5090 运行 MiniMax H3
topics.summary_short_zh: SlopTV 是一套完全在本地运行的 YouTube 直播流水线：先由大语言模型将直播聊天中的提示词扩写为约 400 词的结构化视频提示词，再通过双 RTX 5090 上的 MiniMax H3 生成 15 秒视频片段，最后回传到同一直播流；源码已发布在 GitHub，灵感来自 infiniteslop。

x_buzz.title: Meta’s Muse Code exits beta with an SDK and subscriptions
x_buzz.summary: Meta’s Muse Code exits beta with an SDK and subscriptions : Meta pushed Muse Code into general availability, positioning it as a bigger-task coding agent with a developer-preview SDK for embedding custom agents, connecting tools, streaming progress, and resuming sessions.
